function.name: run_shell
function.description: Run Windows shell to interact with operating system.

function.name: manage_reminder
function.description: create or finish a reminder to user

trigger_time.description: How many seconds from now until the reminder should trigger.

content.description: A short description of the reminder

function.name: control_light
function.description: Controls light. Can turn it on/off, and adjust brightness or color temperature.

device.description: Which light to control, and what lights are only available.

switch_led.description: Turn the light on (true) or off (false).

bright_value.description: Brightness level, 10 (dimmest) to 1000 (brightest). Only applies when switch_led is true.

temp_value.description: Color temperature, 0 (warm) to 1000 (cool). do not apply unless said otherwise.

colour_data.description: Optional HSV color string (hex-encoded: hue+saturation+value) if switching to colour mode.
